Name: Stardew Discord Notifier
Author: TamKungZ
Description:
[size=5][b]Stardew Discord Notifier[/b][/size]
[line]
Start every in-game day with your farm's latest update in Discord. Pick the details
you care about and make the notification your own.

[size=4][b]A little news from the farm[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Today's outlook:[/b] date, weather, luck, birthdays, and festivals.[/*]
[*][b]Your farm:[/b] each player's gold with separate wallets, or shared funds.[/*]
[*][b]Your people:[/b] spouse or roommate, closest villager and heart level, plus online players. Steam players link to their profiles when available.[/*]
[*][b]Your style:[/b] choose which details to include, set the bot name and avatar, and use an embed or plain message.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Works with your multiplayer farm[/b][/size]
Give each player their own webhook, or share one between players. Different webhooks
get their own update; a shared webhook gets one update, not duplicates. Webhook URLs
aren't shared between players. Everyone needs version 2.0.0 or later.

[size=4][b]Quick setup[/b][/size]
Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url], then add
the mod to your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder. In Discord, create a webhook
for your channel and paste its URL into Generic Mod Config Menu or
[font=Courier New]config.json[/font]. Use [font=Courier New]sdn_test[/font] in the
SMAPI console to check the connection.

Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. English and Thai are included.

Downloads.Description: Get a fresh Discord update each morning with the day's weather, luck, events, player gold, and farm details. Customize your message and use separate multiplayer webhooks without duplicate posts.

Manifest.Name: Stardew Discord Notifier
Manifest.Description: Sends a Discord webhook notification in channel when a new day starts in Stardew Valley.
